world.name: Zephyr
world.description: A world where three fundamental energies shape existence: Mana, Aura/Qi, and Primal Essence.

fundamental_energies.name: Mana
fundamental_energies.description: Magical energy drawn from the world's mana veins and ambient sources. Powers spellcasting, enchantments, and arcane constructs.

fundamental_energies.name: Aura
fundamental_energies.description: Life force manifested through discipline. External expression — enhances weapons, body, and creates combat domains.

fundamental_energies.name: Qi
fundamental_energies.description: Internal energy cultivated through training, meditation, and near-death experiences. Sect-exclusive system refined within the self.
fundamental_energies.relationship_to_aura: Aura is force imposed on the world. Qi is force refined within the self.

fundamental_energies.name: Primal Essence
fundamental_energies.description: The raw essence of nature and beasts. Powers totem-based systems, shapeshifting, and sentient ecosystems.

main.name: Arcaelis
main.title: The Mana Dominion
main.motto: Where knowledge is power, and power corrupts reality.
main.overview: A fractured continent of independent magical nations, unstable mana zones, and ancient consequences. No empire rules — only competing powers, hidden agendas, and dangerous knowledge.
main.unique_twist: Magic is overused, causing mana storms, reality distortions, and forbidden zones called 'Fractures'.

races.name: High Elves
races.traits: Guardians of Yggdrasil, pure mana users

races.name: Dwarves (Runic Engineers)
races.traits: Rune forges, anti-magic architecture, stability keepers

races.name: Undead
races.traits: Cursed remnants of war, sentient & feral variants

races.name: Slimes
races.traits: Adaptive magical organisms, used as containers, experiment tools, living weapons

races.name: Humans
races.traits: Reject extreme magic dependence, tactical warfare, arcane restraint

regions.name: Thaldrim Peaks
regions.description: A massive mountain wall separating Arcaelis from the unknown north.

civilization.name: Kharad-Thal Dominion
details: Rune forges powered by magma + mana veins
Anti-magic architecture (stable zones in unstable continent)
Deep tunnels rumored to reach pre-Fracture civilizations

regions.name: Aetherplateau
regions.location: Below mountains, top-left of the Trilake

nations.name: Velmoran Ascendancy
nations.capital_description: Floating towers orbiting a volatile mana core
society: Divided into Mage Houses (like noble families)
Spying, sabotage, and magical espionage common

nations.name: Solvara
nations.location: East of Key Forest (Golems live), east to mountains
identity: Humans who reject extreme magic dependence
nations.role: Stabilizing political force against mage chaos

regions.name: Mythsylva (Forest of Myths)
regions.description: Sacred forest built around the World Tree Yggdrasil.

key_locations.name: Yggdrasil (World Tree)
key_locations.description: Source of pure mana. Stabilizes mana across Arcaelis. Roots extend beneath entire continent.
key_locations.secret: Damage to Yggdrasil = continent-wide magical collapse

key_locations.name: Temple of Aeralith (Lost Temple)
key_locations.description: Sealed ancient magic, possibly pre-Fracture civilization.

regions.name: Vorthal Canyon
regions.location: East of Trilake, river flows between this canyon
regions.description: A massive canyon dividing the land.

golden_mountain.description: A time dragon lives here, below mountain range

titan_spine.name: The Titan Spine
titan_spine.description: A colossal dragon skeleton stretching across the canyon, parallel to the river.
details: Some ribs act as natural bridges
Scholars believe: 'The creature is not fully dead.'

regions.name: Astryx Lake (Trilake)
regions.description: A rare natural wonder shaped like a bird in flight (3 connected lakes).

civilization.name: Aurelios Port City
civilization.description: Richest trade city in Arcaelis. Connects continents via sea routes.
culture: Information trading more valuable than goods

regions.name: Necroth – Land of the Dead
regions.description: A cursed region where death is not the end. A broken afterlife gateway.

regions.name: Mycelara
regions.description: Dense mushroom forests and alchemical ecosystems.

key_location.name: Elixhaven
key_location.title: Potionist Capital
details: Entire city built around living labs
Slimes used as containers, experiment tools, living weapons

unique_effects: Air filled with spores affecting mind, mana flow, and emotions

regions.name: Nyxveil Mistlands
unknown: Some believe a hidden ancient race exists
OR it is a living fracture entity

regions.name: Kashirin Desert
regions.location: Right of the huge skeleton (Titan Spine)
details: Sand turned to glass in places

regions.name: Thornbound Reach
regions.description: Dense, mana-draining vegetation. Acts as a natural border barrier.

regions.name: Voltyra Exclusion Zone
regions.description: Constant lightning storms. Failed experiment by Velmoran mages.

regions.name: Blightroot Forest
regions.description: Final destination of Serpentis Flow. Poisoned, necrotic ecosystem.
details: Water turns black near this region

history.description: Yggdrasil stabilizes entire continent. Magic safe and balanced.
Titan Wyrm (now Titan Spine) ruled mana flow. Slain by combined races.
Elves vs Human mages. Forbidden magic spreads.
Necroth created. Souls trapped → undead rise.
Mana instability increasing. Nations competing for control. Ancient zones awakening.

main.name: Valkryn
main.title: The Aura Dominion
main.motto: Strength defines truth. Weakness defines fate.
main.overview: A war-forged continent where Aura — the manifestation of life force through discipline — reigns supreme. Magic is rare and distrusted; the body and weapon are everything. Strength isn't just respected — it is law, currency, and identity.
main.unique_twist: Aura users can break physical laws — speed beyond sound, weapon techniques that cut mountains.

races.name: Trolls
races.traits: Regenerative beasts, lava-adapted variants in south

regions.name: Grimfang Highlands
regions.description: Harsh mountains, thin air, extreme cold nights. Natural training ground for elite warriors.

key_location.name: Kraghollow Bastion
key_location.structure: Vertical city, rank floors (stronger = higher level access)

regions.culture: Strength-based hierarchy. Leaders earn rank through combat, not lineage.

regions.name: Dravokar Corelands
regions.description: Heart of warriors, rulers, and structured civilization.
features: Grand Arena of Drakthar — rank determines status
regions.culture: Strict honor code. Duels settle disputes. Weak are either trained… or erased.

regions.name: Veltorn Plains
regions.description: Vast open lands, perfect for cavalry and large battles.
regions.culture: Strategy + strength balance. War academies train children from young age.

regions.name: Skyreach Canopies
regions.description: Massive forests with towering trees reaching clouds.

regions.name: Feral Veil
regions.description: Untamed land where only beast riders survive. Dense forests, massive creatures, hidden tribes.
features: Living jungles that react to Aura

rules: If beast dies → rider weakens permanently

regions.name: Emberclaw Badlands
regions.description: Volcanic terrain, ash storms, lava rivers. Most dangerous area.
regions.culture: Lawless. Survival of the strongest. Very few strong humans here.

regions.name: Sanctis Basin
regions.description: The only place where killing is forbidden. All major warriors eventually rely on Sanctis Vale for survival. Within the basin are 7 mountain plains: 6 are controlled by the 4 great clans, and 1 by Sanctis Vale (Medic Town). Legend speaks of 10 ancient sects, implying 3 plains remain hidden.

key_location.name: Sanctis Vale
key_location.title: Medic Town
key_location.description: Qi-based healing, later all kinds of medic treatments, now open for Aura users too.

regions.rule: Breaking peace here results in ALL factions hunting you down.
regions.culture: Neutral ground. Even enemies respect its sanctity.

levels.name: Aura Projection
levels.description: Channel Aura into weapons, shockwaves, ranged attacks

levels.name: Aura Domain
levels.description: Create a personal combat field (gravity shift, pressure zones, etc.)

levels.name: Law Break
levels.description: Move faster than sound, cut intangible objects, distort space slightly

cultivation_methods: Training & Combat in areas with Qi

levels.name: Spark Initiate
levels.description: Qi sensing, minor enhancement, opening meridians

levels.name: Core Awakening
levels.description: Formation of internal core / energy center, instinct sharpening

levels.name: War Aspect
levels.description: Unique combat identity (weapon style, aura, technique evolution)

levels.name: Domain Weaver
levels.description: Partial area influence, control over battlefield flow

levels.name: Domain Breaker
levels.description: Overwrites enemy domains, absolute pressure zone

levels.name: Mythic Ascendant
levels.description: Transcendent being, law-level influence (beyond normal Qi)

sects.name: Azure Wind Sect
sects.territory: Secret cove behind a waterfall near ancient ruins in Sanctis Basin
sects.status: Newly emerging, secretly gathered by a young man who found ancient scrolls

bond_types.description: Life linked (if one dies, both die)

beast_rider_system.rules: Not all beasts can be tamed — depends on tamer's skills. Only bonded beasts accept coexistence. Wild beasts remain hostile and far stronger.

history.description: Once ruled by a single war emperor. Aura overuse caused land destruction.
Endless wars between species. No unity.
Void Demon Sect nearly destroyed Valkryn. Led to banning forbidden Aura arts.
Alliances exist — but fragile. War can start anytime.

current_conflicts: Void Demon Sect secretly rising again
Beast Riders losing control over stronger creatures
Tension between Orc dominance & Human strategy factions
Sanctis Vale under threat (if it falls → chaos)

main.name: Thrynthal
main.title: The Primal Wilds
main.motto: Nature is not kind — it is absolute.
main.overview: A continent of Birdmen, Beastmen, and shapeshifters where nature itself is alive and absolute.

special_regions.name: Atlanthys (The Sunken Empire)
special_regions.description: A vast underwater domain surrounding the submerged island of Atlan. Three sea tribes — Mermans, Whale-men, and Sea Beastmen — guard its waters with fierce territorial control.

sub_locations.name: Atlan
sub_locations.description: Once a flourishing human civilization that maintained trade and friendship with the Mermans. 3,000 years ago, during an attempt to stabilize the world's mana balance, they nearly succeeded — but a traitor's influence caused a catastrophe that destroyed Atlan entirely. All inhabitants perished. The traitor is now sealed within the ruins — the sole human remaining on Atlan.

seal.description: The Mermans sealed the rift that formed underwater by creating powerful whirlpools surrounding Atlan. The entire area is marked as a restricted zone, strictly guarded as sacred duty by all three sea tribes.

legend.public_knowledge: A legend says that once, mermaids were friends with humans. Now the sea tribes consider humans enemies and refuse all contact.

special_regions.secret: Atlan was once one of the world's greatest human civilizations. A traitor sealed within caused its fall. The mermans guard the ruins to prevent anyone from reaching the sealed traitor.

special_regions.name: The Shattered Veil (Archipelago)
special_regions.description: Portal islands connecting continents. Ancient teleportation ruins. Neutral trading zone.

special_regions.name: Aerelion – The Floating Kingdom
special_regions.description: A landmass held by ancient anti-gravity magic cores.

special_regions.name: Nimboria – The Cloud Kingdom
special_regions.description: A kingdom of peace, literally built on clouds. A legend that most people believe exists but no one has ever seen. The landmass was placed in the sky 5,000 years ago by the titan Hazin, who was magically enlarged by Dakota to the size of a continent to physically lift it.

legend.public_knowledge: A legend of a kingdom in the clouds — no one alive has seen it, but it is believed to be there.

history.description: 5,000 years ago, the landmass of Pirion and the future Cloud Kingdom were one — created by the god Aetherion himself. Constant wars ravaged the land. Dakota, a supremely powerful magician, split the landmass to end the fighting. But the separated piece could not remain on the surface. Years later, Dakota used enhancing magic to grow Hazin — already the largest Titan ever born — to the size of a continent. Hazin physically lifted the landmass into the clouds, where it became Nimboria. He became known as 'The Giant Who Touched the Sky.'

special_regions.name: Pirion – The Square-Shaped Island
special_regions.description: The remaining half of a landmass split by Dakota 5,000 years ago. Once joined with what became Nimboria, Pirion was called the Kingdom of Ruins after the split. Now cursed and home to shapeshifters.
features: Ruins of the original unified landmass

history.description: Originally one landmass with Nimboria, created by Aetherion. Constant wars led Dakota to split it 5,000 years ago. Pirion remained behind while the other half was lifted to the clouds by Hazin. After the split, Pirion decayed into a cursed ruin.

special_regions.secret: The original unified landmass was created by the god Aetherion. Its division was one of Dakota's greatest acts of power.

extreme_continents.name: Titanor – Land of Giants
extreme_continents.description: Home to Titans and Colossi. Mountains are the ancient bodies of fallen giants. Hazin, the greatest Titan ever born, came from here — so large that other Titans looked small beside him.

extreme_continents.name: Yokaishi – Spirit World
extreme_continents.description: Ghosts, Yokai, cursed beings. Time flows differently.

extreme_continents.name: Primordia – Dino World
extreme_continents.description: Dinosaurs + advanced tribal humans. Most intelligent but primitive-looking.

extreme_continents.name: Saurix – Dino-men Continent
extreme_continents.description: Evolved dinosaur humanoids. Highly strategic civilization.

extreme_continents.name: Mechanis – Human Tech Continent
extreme_continents.description: Cyber cities, AI systems, anti-magic weapons.
extreme_continents.conflict: They want to dominate all magic users.

extreme_continents.name: Serpenthis – Snake Continent
extreme_continents.description: Reptilian races. Constant tension with fairies.

description.text: Young man with sharp, observant eyes. Travels light — worn coat, minimal gear, built for speed not comfort.

traits.text: Recognizes names and events he shouldn't know.
Carries a crystal shard pointing east and an ancient coin.

secrets.text: Carries artifacts tied to pre-Fracture civilization.

description.text: Old man with white hair pulled back, spectacles on a twice-broken nose.

traits.text: Measured, talkative when comfortable, trades in information as much as goods. Perceptive — notices more than he lets on.

description.text: Tall woman in well-worn traveler's leathers, carrying a staff wrapped in dark cloth. Unusually pale for a road-dweller.

traits.text: Confident, composed, observant. Commands respect in Halwen — given free drinks at The Dry Creek. Speaks with precision.

secrets.text: Knows about the sealed entity beneath the Titan Spine. Background unknown.

story_npcs.name: Azure Wind Sect Leader
story_npcs.appearance: A promising young man with a swift and light-footed bearing.
story_npcs.traits: Ambitious and resourceful. Found a secret cove behind a waterfall containing combat scrolls from a lost ancient sect.
story_npcs.secrets: He claims to have found one of the 3 missing 'Legendary 10 Sects' of Sanctis. Only he knows the true history from the scrolls he recovered.

deities.name: Aetherion
deities.description: The god who created the world of Zephyr. His power was singular and absolute. When he was struck down by a powerful outer god, his death shattered the one landmass into the continents that exist today, and his one power fractured into three separate energies: Mana, Aura, and Qi.
deities.status: Dead — his followers seek to resurrect him
connections: Created the unified landmass including Pirion-Nimboria
His death caused the continental split and the birth of the three energies
His followers form a secret faction working toward resurrection

deities.name: The Outer God
deities.description: A powerful entity from beyond the world that struck down Aetherion. Now sealed somewhere in Zephyr. Its location is one of the world's greatest secrets.
connections: Killed Aetherion with a single strike
Sealed by unknown forces after Aetherion's death
Its prison's location is the most dangerous secret in the world

deities.name: Kaleris
deities.description: A legendary mage god said to have helped humanity 8,000 years ago during a catastrophic event. The details are lost to time, but Kaleris is the most widely followed deity across all races. Most temples, academies, and magical institutions invoke his name.
connections: Helped humanity survive an ancient catastrophe 8,000 years ago
Most widely worshipped deity across all races

dragon.name: Dragon
dragon.note: Time Dragon lives at Golden Mountain in Vorthal Canyon. Titan Wyrm (deceased) forms the Titan Spine.

story_locations.name: Halwen
story_locations.location: Eastern edge of Solvara, near trade roads to Aurelios Port
story_locations.description: A small border village of about two hundred souls, nestled along a dried creek bed. The kind of place that exists between maps. Home to Garret's Provisions and The Dry Creek tavern.

story_locations.name: Solvara
story_locations.description: A stabilizing political force that rejects extreme magic dependence. Uses controlled spellcasting, enchanted weapons, and tactical warfare. Military academies train arcane restraint.

story_locations.name: Arcaelis — The Mana Dominion
story_locations.description: A fractured continent of independent magical nations, unstable mana zones, and ancient consequences. No empire rules — only competing powers, hidden agendas, and dangerous knowledge.

story_locations.name: Vorthal Canyon
story_locations.description: A massive canyon dividing the land. The Serpentis Flow runs through it. The colossal Titan Spine stretches across it — a dragon skeleton infused with ancient mana. Something beneath it may still live.

story_locations.name: Serpentis Flow / Serpentis Road
story_locations.description: The primary river running through Vorthal Canyon and the trade road alongside it. Three caravans have vanished without trace on this route recently.

story_locations.name: Kashirin Desert
story_locations.description: Mana-scorched wasteland. Home to the Ashkar Nomads (anti-magic warriors) and the Kashirin Tribe, who believe in the Dakota prophecy and guard the desert.

story_locations.name: Mythsylva — Forest of Myths
story_locations.description: Sacred forest built around Yggdrasil, the World Tree. Home to the Lunareth Enclave of High Elves. The enclave has gone silent — no messengers for weeks. Leaves turning silver.

story_locations.name: Yggdrasil — The World Tree
story_locations.description: Source of pure mana. Stabilizes mana across the entire continent of Arcaelis. Roots extend beneath the full landmass. Damage to Yggdrasil would cause continent-wide magical collapse. Leaves are turning silver.

story_locations.name: Lunareth Enclave
story_locations.description: High Elf civilization built around the branches of Yggdrasil. Capital: Lunareth. Recently gone completely silent — no trade or messengers.

story_locations.name: The Titan Spine
story_locations.description: A colossal dragon skeleton stretching across the canyon. Bones infused with ancient mana, some ribs serve as natural bridges. Recent reports of breathing sounds underneath. Something is sealed beneath it — older than the Wyrm itself.

story_locations.name: Aurelios Port City
story_locations.description: Richest trade city in Arcaelis. Connects continents via sea routes. Merchant guilds dominate. Information trading more valuable than goods. Neutral ground for all factions.

story_locations.name: Velmoran Ascendancy
story_locations.description: Powerful mage nation with capital Velmora Spire — floating towers orbiting a volatile mana core. Divided into Mage Houses. Currently downplaying mana instability.

story_locations.name: Aetherplateau
story_locations.description: Elevated landmass hosting the Velmoran Ascendancy, Solvara, and other nations. Political heart of Arcaelis.

world_secrets.name: The Death of Aetherion
world_secrets.description: The god Aetherion created the world and all its lands. He was struck down by a powerful outer god. His death shattered the one landmass into continents and fractured his singular power into Mana, Aura, and Qi.

world_secrets.name: The Outer God is Sealed
world_secrets.description: The outer god that killed Aetherion is sealed somewhere in Zephyr. Its prison's location is the most dangerous secret in the world.

world_secrets.name: Aetherion's Followers
world_secrets.description: A secret faction of Aetherion's followers is actively working to resurrect the creator god.

world_secrets.name: The Whithir Collapse
world_secrets.description: All continents were once one landmass, shattered when Aetherion died — his power splitting into Mana, Aura, and Qi.

world_secrets.name: The Giant Who Touched the Sky
world_secrets.description: Hazin, a Titan from Titanor, was enhanced by Dakota's magic to the size of a continent. He physically lifted the separated landmass into the clouds, creating Nimboria — the Cloud Kingdom.

world_secrets.name: Dakota Split the Land
world_secrets.description: 5,000 years ago, Dakota — a supremely powerful magician — split the Pirion-Nimboria landmass in two to end constant wars. The divided piece was later placed in the clouds by Hazin.

world_secrets.name: The Fall of Atlan
world_secrets.description: 3,000 years ago, the human island Atlan attempted to stabilize the world's mana balance. They nearly succeeded, but a traitor's influence caused a catastrophe that destroyed the entire civilization. The traitor is sealed within the ruins — the sole human remaining on Atlan.

world_secrets.name: The Merman Seal
world_secrets.description: After Atlan's fall, the Mermans sealed the underwater rift with whirlpools surrounding the ruins. All three sea tribes (Mermans, Whale-men, Sea Beastmen) guard it as a restricted zone. They lost friendship with humans and now consider them enemies.

world_secrets.name: Mermaids Were Once Friends
world_secrets.description: A legend persists that once, mermaids and humans were allies and friends. The sea tribes now deny this and view all humans with hostility.

world_secrets.name: Yggdrasil Vulnerability
world_secrets.description: Damage to Yggdrasil = continent-wide magical collapse across Arcaelis.

world_secrets.name: Titan Spine Lives
world_secrets.description: The Titan Wyrm skeleton stretching across Vorthal Canyon may not be fully dead.

world_secrets.name: Necroth – Broken Afterlife
world_secrets.description: Necroth is not just a cursed region — it is a broken afterlife gateway.

world_secrets.name: Aerelion Destruction
world_secrets.description: If the floating kingdom Aerelion falls → global destruction.

world_secrets.name: Atlan Was a Great Civilization
world_secrets.description: Atlan was once a flourishing human civilization that maintained trade and friendship with Mermans. Its destruction is one of the world's greatest tragedies.

world_secrets.name: Lost City of Gold
world_secrets.description: A hidden lost city of Gold exists in the center of Necroth.

world_secrets.name: Time Dragon
world_secrets.description: A time dragon lives at the Golden Mountain below the mountain range in Vorthal Canyon.

world_secrets.name: Void Demon Sect Rising
world_secrets.description: The Void Demon Sect is secretly rising again in Valkryn.

world_secrets.name: Dakota Prophecy
world_secrets.description: The Kashirin Tribe believes in and protects the desert for the Dakota prophecy.

world_secrets.name: Kaleris — The Mage God
world_secrets.description: A mage god said to have helped humanity 8,000 years ago in a catastrophic event. A legend, but most people follow him as a deity. The most worshipped figure across all civilizations.

world_secrets.name: The Cloud Kingdom Legend
world_secrets.description: A legend of a kingdom in the clouds — no one living has seen it, but it is believed to exist. In truth, it is Nimboria, placed there by Hazin 5,000 years ago.

world_secrets.name: The Lost Sects of Sanctis
world_secrets.description: Legend states there were 10 great ancient sects. In Sanctis Basin, only 7 mountain plains are known (6 used by clans, 1 by medic town). A young man recently found one of the missing 3 in a secret cove behind a waterfall forming the new Azure Wind Sect. The remaining 2 ancient sect locations are still completely hidden, their ruins and scrolls lost to time.
